domain.summary: Development workflow management across domain-owning repositories: a desktop that drives agent sessions, a connector that distributes engineering doctrine, and a local-first service for knowledge, quests and shared records.
owns: the canon — core rules, knowledge and skills, and the packs
the doctrine CLI: sync, check, upstream, analyze, doctor
the knowledge service: indexing, search, convergence detection, the registry
quests — how one repository asks another for work
the local driver, session lifecycle, review and workflow gates
the desktop and shared React platform
the shared dev toolkit and its universal gates
accepts: a rule or knowledge document that two or more repositories derived independently
a pack proposal, with the repositories that agree on it
a correction to canonical doctrine, with the evidence that it is wrong
a gap in the CLI, service, devkit, driver or platform, with the case that exposes it
